ttl.name: Front Seat Outer Belt Assembly RH

s-1.ptxt: Dispose of Front Seat Outer Belt Assembly RH (When Installed in Vehicle)

s3.ptxt: Using a thin-bladed screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, pull out the locking button toward you, release the lock and disconnect the connector.

item.ptxt: Check that there is no looseness in the installation part of the front seat outer belt assembly RH.
Check that there is no slack in the seat belt.

s3.ptxt: Connect the following 2 SSTs.
Short the alligator clip and terminal of the SST.
Connect the SST to the pretensioner and lock the locking button.

atten4.ptxt: When connecting the SST to the pretensioner, connect it with the locking button in the locked state.

s3.ptxt: Extend the SST fully from the vehicle and place the battery 5m or more away from the vehicle.

atten2.ptxt: Close all doors and door glass.

s3.ptxt: Check that the vehicle interior and surrounding area are safe, and connect the SST alligator clip to the negative battery terminal.
Touch the SST terminal to the positive battery terminal to activate the pretensioner.

item.ptxt: Before deployment, always make sure that there is no one inside the cabin or in the surrounding area.
Before deployment, always warn people around the work area in a loud voice.

s3.ptxt: Place the activated pretensioner in a strong, transparent plastic bag, seal it and dispose of it.

item.ptxt: Some parts of an activated pretensioner can be several hundred °C or more, so leave it for 30 minutes or more after activation.
Do not apply water, etc. to an activated pretensioner.
When handling an activated pretensioner, wear dustproof protective glasses and gloves.
After work is completed, be sure to wash your hands with water.
Never dispose of a pretensioner in an unactivated state.

s-1.ptxt: Dispose of Front Seat Outer Belt Assembly RH (When not Installed in Vehicle)

s3.ptxt: Retract the seat belt into the retractor.
With the seat belt fully retracted, cut the seat belt at a position 10cm from the retractor.

atten4.ptxt: Fully retracting the seat belt increases the retraction resistance during activation.

s3.ptxt: Connect the following 2 SSTs.
Short the alligator clip and terminal of the SST.
Connect the SST to the pretensioner and lock the locking button.

atten4.ptxt: When connecting the SST to the pretensioner, connect it with the locking button in the locked state.

s3.ptxt: Using a wire harness (conductor cross-sectional area 1.25mm2or more), secure the pretensioner to a tire with wheel (tire width approximately 185mm) with the pretensioner connector facing up.
Pass the SST over the top of the tire.

atten3.ptxt: Passing it under the tire may damage the SST.

s3.ptxt: Extend the SST fully from the tire with wheel, and place the battery 5m or more away.
Check that the surrounding area is safe, and connect the SST alligator clip to the negative battery terminal.

item.ptxt: Perform the work outdoors on a level surface where safety can be ensured. Also, avoid activation in residential areas, etc. as much as possible.
Since the activation sound is very loud, make sure in advance that people in the surrounding area are informed of the activation.

s3.ptxt: Use pylons and rope, etc. to enclose the area so that no one enters within a radius of 5m from the outside of the tire.
Touch the SST terminal to the positive battery terminal to activate the pretensioner.

item.ptxt: Before deployment, always make sure that there is no one in the surrounding area.
Before deployment, always warn people around the work area in a loud voice.

s3.ptxt: Place the activated pretensioner in a strong, transparent plastic bag, seal it and dispose of it.

item.ptxt: Some parts of an activated pretensioner can be several hundred °C or more, so leave it for 30 minutes or more after activation.
Do not apply water, etc. to an activated pretensioner.
When handling an activated pretensioner, wear dustproof protective glasses and gloves.
After work is completed, be sure to wash your hands with water.
Never dispose of a pretensioner in an unactivated state.
